name: TIMER2_immune_estimation
description: Estimate immune cell abundance in TCGA cancer samples using TIMER-equivalent marker gene expression from cBioPortal. Returns infiltration proxies for 6 immune cell types (B cells, CD4+ T cells, CD8+ T cells, neutrophils, macrophages, dendritic cells) using canonical marker genes (CD19, CD4, CD8A, FCGR3B, CD68, ITGAX). Note: TIMER2.0/3.0 REST API is no longer public; this tool uses cBioPortal TCGA data as a proxy.

gene.description: Optional gene symbol to correlate with immune infiltration (e.g., 'CD8A', 'PDCD1')

immune_infiltration.description: Per immune cell type: the marker gene, the mean and median of its expression over the sampled tumours, and the number of samples that had a value. With a correlate gene, also the Spearman r over the samples the two genes SHARE -- which is what n_paired_samples reports, and what the positional pairing it replaces did not compute.

n_paired_samples.description: Samples with a value for BOTH genes, which is what the correlation is over

n_samples.description: How many samples were REQUESTED, which is the cap and not the study's size. See study_sample_total.

study_sample_total.description: How many samples the study has. BRCA has over a thousand and the default estimate reads the first 100, so the mean and median are over a subset.

samples_are_a_subset.description: True when fewer samples were used than the study has

sampling.description: States that the samples are the first max_samples cBioPortal lists, in its own order, and not a random sample

max_samples.description: The cap in force, raisable up to 1000

method.description: How the estimate was computed. Measured value: 'Marker gene expression (CD19, CD4, CD8A, FCGR3B, CD68, ITGAX) via cBioPortal TCGA data' -- six marker genes read off bulk expression, which is not a deconvolution and does not give cell fractions.

note.description: Where the result actually came from. Measured value: 'TIMER2.0/3.0 API is unavailable; using cBioPortal TCGA expression as proxy'. The estimate is a fallback, not TIMER's own deconvolution -- read this before reporting it as a TIMER result.

profile_id.description: The expression profile used, e.g. 'brca_tcga_rna_seq_v2_mrna'. Names the study and assay behind the numbers.

name: TIMER2_gene_correlation
description: Analyze Spearman correlation between two genes across TCGA cancer samples using cBioPortal data. Returns correlation coefficient and p-value. Useful for identifying co-expressed genes in tumor microenvironment. Note: TIMER2.0/3.0 REST API is no longer public; uses cBioPortal as data source. Example: Correlate CD8A and PDCD1 expression in BRCA.

note.description: Where the result came from. Measured value: 'TIMER2.0/3.0 API unavailable; correlation computed from cBioPortal TCGA expression'. The correlation is a fallback computed locally, not TIMER's own output.

profile_id.description: The expression profile the correlation was computed on, e.g. 'brca_tcga_rna_seq_v2_mrna'. Names the study and the assay.

name: TIMER2_survival_association
description: Analyze overall survival association of gene expression in TCGA cancer patients using cBioPortal data. Performs log-rank test comparing high vs. low gene expression groups (median split). Returns log-rank p-value, median survival times, and event counts. Note: TIMER2.0/3.0 REST API is no longer public; uses cBioPortal TCGA data.

log_rank_statistic.description: The log-rank test statistic, e.g. -2.1238. Signed, so it carries the direction as well as the magnitude; the p-value is reported separately.

median_expression_cutoff.description: The expression value patients were split into high and low groups at, e.g. 152.2146. This is a MEDIAN split, not an optimised cutpoint, so the split is cohort-specific and not transferable.

note.description: Where the result actually came from. Measured value: 'TIMER2.0/3.0 API unavailable; survival computed from cBioPortal TCGA data' -- the tool fell back to a DIFFERENT database and recorded it only here. Read this field before attributing the result to TIMER.

profile_id.description: The expression profile the analysis ran on, e.g. 'brca_tcga_rna_seq_v2_mrna'. Names the study and the assay, which the gene name alone does not.
